verdict.rationale: Opting out of AI model training is a fair question for a cloud-backed AI coding agent like Slate, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a data retention policy, or a privacy control over code and prompts. Permission controls (allow/ask/deny) govern which actions the agent may take, not data use, and bug-report diagnostics are unrelated, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
